about.p1: BMG (Build Market Group) is a construction marketplace in Uzbekistan. It connects buyers and sellers of building materials: only sellers set prices.
about.p2: The calculator picks materials for your site. The estimate is approximate: confirm exact figures with a specialist and the site foreman.
about.r1: Sellers state their own prices and stock.
about.r3: Complaints and disputed orders are reviewed by the BMG team.
